content: Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of severe side effects. It is essential to maintain a comprehensive list of all the products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this information with your doctor and pharmacist. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. While using this medication, laboratory and medical tests, such as kidney function assessments, should be conducted regularly. If you miss a dose of this medication, it is crucial to follow specific instructions based on the form of the medication. For missed injections, consult your doctor or pharmacist promptly to establish a new dosing schedule. If you miss an inhaled dose, use it as soon as you remember, unless it is close to the time of your next dose. In that case, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. For colistimethate used as an inhalation, store unmixed vials at room temperature. Do not use premixed solutions or prepare the solution in advance, as this increases the risk of severe breathing problems. Always prepare the inhalation solution immediately before use and discard any unused solution after 24 hours. Do not store the solution for extended periods or in the bathroom. Properly dispose of expired or unused medication as instructed by your healthcare provider. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless directed to do so. Colistimethate is an antibiotic used to treat specific bacterial infections. For injections, it is typically administered into a vein or muscle as directed by your doctor. Before use, visually inspect the product for particles or discoloration. Do not use the liquid if either is present. If inhaling this medication, learn how to prepare the solution and use the nebulizer machine correctly. To achieve the best results, use this antibiotic at evenly spaced intervals and continue the full prescribed course, even if symptoms improve after a few days. Stopping the medication prematurely may allow the infection to return. Common side effects may include stomach upset and itching. However, this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks. Rarely, this medication may cause a severe intestinal condition due to a bacteria called Clostridioides difficile (C. difficile), which can occur during treatment or weeks to months after treatment has stopped. Prolonged or repeated use of this medication may lead to a new infection. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare but possible. If you experience any unusual or severe symptoms, contact your doctor immediately. Before using colistimethate, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, polymyxin B, colistin, or any other substances. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. This medication may cause dizziness, and consuming alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate this effect. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or performing tasks requiring alertness until you can do so safely. Limit alcoholic beverages. This medication may interfere with the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines, such as the typhoid vaccine. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk, so consult your doctor before breastfeeding. This document is a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. It is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
